name: weak-tie-threshold
description: The transition found in pilot P-5, as a proper design. Ten disconnected neighbourhoods with a varying share of encounters drawn from the weak citywide layer. Below roughly 0.2% of encounters, neighbourhood cultures persist indefinitely; above roughly 0.75%, the city homogenises completely; between-replicate variance peaks inside the transition. This is a threshold in a STRUCTURAL parameter, not a migration one -- which is why it must be swept in any design that claims to locate a migration threshold (A-019). Run to convergence and check interactable_pair_fraction before interpreting anything.
